lines: d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Grayson Boyd is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d30: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d30: 🕯️ Grayson Boyd is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d30: What Grayson kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d30: "Grayson's gone." Lorenzo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Grayson." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d30: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lillian blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d30: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Grayson Boyd, 30 days. The mantle passes to Lillian Gomez.
d30: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lillian Gomez, 23 — a florist. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d30: The village's quarrel was with Grayson — and Grayson is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d30: At the grave, Lorenzo, Paisley, Victor and 3 more speak for Lillian — "Grayson trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d30: The fire knew Lillian before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
